description: This file defines the `VoiceWakeRecognitionDebugSupport` enum with nested structs and static functions related to voice wake word detection, transcript logging, and matching logic.

classes.name: VoiceWakeRecognitionDebugSupport
classes.description: An enumeration encapsulating static methods and nested types to support voice wake recognition debugging.

classes.name: TranscriptSummary
classes.description: A struct representing a summary of a transcript, indicating if it is text-only and the count of timing segments.

methods.name: shouldLogTranscript
methods.description: Determines whether a transcript should be logged based on content, logger level, repeat intervals, and prior logging state.

methods.name: textOnlyFallbackMatch
methods.description: Attempts to produce a WakeWordGateMatch if the transcript matches a text-only command trigger.

methods.name: transcriptSummary
methods.description: Generates a summary indicating if the transcript is text-only and counts wake word segments.

methods.name: matchSummary
methods.description: Returns a string summarizing the match status and details of a WakeWordGateMatch.
